Saudi Prince Died in London Hotel After Alcohol and Drugs, Coroner Rules

A coroner's inquest has determined that a Saudi prince died in a London hotel in 2025. The ruling stated that the cause of death was a combination of alcohol and drugs. The incident occurred at a luxury hotel in London.
